title.zh: 鲸河马类及化石近亲来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Whippomorpha to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开鲸河马类及化石近亲，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 鲸河马类及化石近亲出现窗口

description.en: Open a source-bounded Whippomorpha time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的鲸河马类及化石近亲时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

description.en: Compare Indohyus and Ambulocetus through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较印多霍斯兽属与陆行鲸属；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: Indohyus 劳氏兽科骨层窗口

description.en: Open the rounded 47.5 Ma window for the Sindkhatudi bone bed in the Upper Subathu Group, where skulls RR 207 and RR 208, dense limb bones and sampled teeth anchor the named Indohyus evidence.
description.zh: 打开上苏巴图群 Sindkhatudi 骨层约 4750 万年前的窗口；RR 207 与 RR 208 头骨、致密肢骨和取样牙齿构成具名 Indohyus 证据锚点。

limitations: Thewissen et al. describe a disarticulated Sindkhatudi sample near Kalakot, India; skulls RR 207–208, limb material and teeth are observations, while aquatic wading and sister-to-Cetacea placement are interpretations of the sampled anatomy and isotope data.

The 48–47 Ma selector is a bounded bone-bed context, not a global raoellid or cetacean FAD/LAD, an origin date, a direct ancestor claim or complete distribution. The CAO2024 frame supplies age context; map markers are sampled records and are not exact fossil-to-map co-locations.

title.zh: Yumaque 组 Peregocetus 原鲸科窗口

description.en: Open the approximately 42.6 Ma window for holotype MUSM 3580, found 1.95 m above the base of the Yumaque Member of Peru's Paracas Formation, to inspect the named quadrupedal-whale evidence.
description.zh: 打开约 4260 万年前的窗口，检查秘鲁 Paracas 组 Yumaque 段底界以上 1.95 米处发现的正模 MUSM 3580 及其具名四足鲸证据。

limitations: MUSM 3580 and its Playa Media Luna locality are direct specimen-and-stratum observations; the approximately 42.6 Ma age is a nannofossil biochronological interpretation, and swimming, weight bearing and a westward route are functional or phylogenetic inferences.

The route sits inside the package's 47–37.7 Ma protocetid sample window and does not establish a global protocetid FAD/LAD, continuous range, direct ancestor or complete dispersal history. The CAO2024 frame is age context, not exact specimen-marker co-registration.

title.en: Basilosaurus Wadi Al Hitan hind-limb window
title.zh: Wadi Al Hitan 龙王鲸后肢窗口

description.en: Open the rounded late-Eocene window for Egyptian Basilosaurus isis material, including the tiny jointed pelvic limb and foot and measured femur UM 93231, beside the linked hind-limb claim.
description.zh: 打开埃及晚始新世龙王鲸材料的约略窗口，结合关联的后肢主张检查微小关节连接骨盆肢与足，以及有测量数据的 UM 93231 股骨。

limitations: Gingerich et al. report named Basilosaurus isis hind-limb material from Wadi Al Hitan; the pelvic limb, foot and UM 93231 femur measurements are specimen observations, while copulatory-guide function and effects on swimming are inferences.

The 41–34 Ma interval is a late-Eocene basilosaurid sample envelope, not a global family FAD/LAD, a complete geographic range or direct ancestry. The CAO2024 frame supplies rounded age context and does not co-register a fossil marker to an exact locality.
